title: Cursor guide
summary: A cursor crosses a component on a curve, hovers the control that matters, clicks; the component answers and the camera leans in, in 5 s.

params.name: image
params.description: the component (path); empty draws a placeholder UI

params.name: button
params.description: the control it clicks (drawn when there is no image)

params.name: background
params.description: a background id from the registry; empty uses the brand's first

usage:
npx paper-motion add cursor-guide --name my-shot
# edit CONFIG in pieces/my-shot/scene.html, then:
npx paper-motion render pieces/my-shot/scene.html --motion-blur 6
notes: Wired to the brand folder: needs brand/tokens.json (a palette and a font pair work) and, for the field, a shader-set entry.
`target` in CONFIG places the control as 0–1 across and down the component; with a real screenshot the drawn button hides and the cursor goes there.

beats.name: Arrive
beats.what: the cursor crosses the component on a curve

beats.name: Click
beats.what: it presses; the camera leans in

when: showing where to click in a real UI
